title: Trace ownership and durability through a failure
description: Inject a serving, storage, or coordination failure and see whether a publish can still cross the configured BookKeeper durability boundary.

scenarios.label: Healthy publish
scenarios.detail: Owner broker, metadata quorum, and all four bookies are reachable.
scenarios.userImpact: The client receives success after the configured number of BookKeeper acknowledgments.
scenarios.operatorMove: Watch publish latency, add-entry latency, ledger rollover, and subscription backlog before changing policy.

scenarios.label: Owner broker crashes
scenarios.detail: BookKeeper and metadata remain healthy; another broker is ready.
scenarios.userImpact: Clients may reconnect or retry during ownership recovery, but acknowledged message data is not lost with the broker.
scenarios.operatorMove: Confirm lookup recovery, managed-ledger recovery time, client retry bounds, and that traffic rebalances away from the failed broker.

scenarios.label: One bookie is unavailable
scenarios.detail: The serving broker and metadata quorum are healthy; three bookies remain.
scenarios.userImpact: Publishes can continue only while enough durable writes satisfy the configured ack quorum.
scenarios.operatorMove: Replace the failed bookie, verify ensemble changes, and restore storage failure margin before another bookie fails.

scenarios.label: BookKeeper quorum loss
scenarios.detail: Only one bookie remains reachable while the owner broker stays up.
scenarios.userImpact: If the ack quorum cannot be met, new persistent publishes must fail or wait instead of returning a false success.
scenarios.operatorMove: Stop unsafe retries from amplifying load, restore bookie capacity, and inspect under-replicated ledger fragments.

scenarios.label: Metadata quorum and broker loss
scenarios.detail: The owner broker fails while the metadata control plane cannot reach quorum.
scenarios.userImpact: Stored entries remain on BookKeeper, but a replacement broker cannot safely establish topic ownership until metadata quorum returns.
scenarios.operatorMove: Restore metadata quorum first, then verify ownership recovery and client lookup before reopening normal traffic.
